3. INTERPRETATION NOTES
------------------------------------------------------------------------
- A repeated base offset suggests a recurring data region, but does not prove its meaning.
- READ/WRITE counts are counts of matched bytecode instructions, not gameplay events.
- Inspect the surrounding method before assigning a semantic name to any field.
